minecraft:lore.text: Right click to leave this
round and return to the lobby
Right click while hidden to look
through the eyes of the creek
Survivors close to it show on your locator bar
Sneak to return to your body
Right click to learn how
each role plays
Right click to show the pages
around you on your locator bar
They show only roughly where they are
Sprinting hides them again
Right click to win back some health
Only once per round
A hit takes from what they give back
Right click to see which
server you are playing on
Right click to hide yourself
or to show yourself again
Right click to play the Slender
next round, one pass is spent
Right click again to cancel
Right click to open your
statistics of this year
Right click to reveal where survivors
walked around you a little while ago
Only you can see the tracks
